fuzz-seeds.description: What fuzz/scripts and ClusterFuzzLite seed the fuzz corpora from: every small fixture. The large budget fixtures are left out because libFuzzer caps input length far below them.

large.description: The budget fixtures: moov beyond the read budget, a four-million-entry sample table, a cue-less live Matroska stream and a long interleaved TS (published, hundreds of MiB each), plus files past 1, 2 and 4 GiB that hydrate synthesises from small seeds, sparse where the format allows. Read by the corpus-large lane.

unit.description: Every small fixture: what the corpus expectations and truncation tests read in the corpus lane.
